findings.current: tears clouded Taishan’s eyes, each as big as a calf’s.
findings.defect: The Korean describes Taishan as being as large as a calf; the current wording instead makes his eyes calf-sized.
findings.rationale: 송아지처럼 커다란 modifies 태산, not his eyes.
findings.replacement: and tears clouded the eyes of Taishan, who was as big as a calf.

findings.current: Even the face of that wild-haired weirdo who gave me a headache every time I saw him made my heart swell with relief.
findings.defect: The assembled English omits the arrival of Gung Gibang and Cheongheoja after the Fire Dragon Pavilion members.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says 궁기방과 청허자 appeared after the Fire Dragon Pavilion members before describing the narrator’s reaction to the wild-haired man.
findings.replacement: Gung Gibang and Cheongheoja appeared after the Fire Dragon Pavilion members. Even the face of that wild-haired weirdo who gave me a headache every time I saw him made my heart swell with relief.

findings.current: Three forces that mixed about as well as water and oil had come together as one, driving through the invaders.
findings.defect: The source calls the three incompatible groups “colors,” preserving a color-mixing image; “forces” removes that image.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 세 가지 색이 하나로 뒤섞인 채: three colors blended together as one.
findings.replacement: Three colors that mixed about as well as water and oil had come together as one, driving through the invaders.

summary: The assembled English is largely faithful, but it omits two characters’ arrival and shifts the source’s image of three colors into one of three forces.
